title: Profile Card
content: Create compact profile card component for user previews. Card structure: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden. Cover: small top banner (h-16) or gradient. Avatar: w-16 h-16 centered, overlapping cover. Content: name (font-semibold text-center), username (text-gray-500), short bio (line-clamp-2). Stats: followers/following counts. Action buttons: "Follow" primary, "Message" secondary. Hover card variant: appears on username hover in feeds. Badge: verified checkmark if applicable.

variants.simple: Create compact profile card with avatar, name, bio, and follow button.
variants.detailed: Create compact profile card component for user previews. Card structure: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden. Cover: small top banner (h-16) or gradient. Avatar: w-16 h-16 centered, overlapping cover. Content: name (font-semibold text-center), username (text-gray-500), short bio (line-clamp-2). Stats: followers/following counts. Action buttons: "Follow" primary, "Message" secondary. Hover card variant: appears on username hover in feeds. Badge: verified checkmark if applicable.
variants.advanced: Create compact profile card component for user previews and hover cards. Card structure: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden, w-72 for standard size or w-full for responsive. Cover: small top banner (h-16) using user cover image or gradient fallback (bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 to-purple-500). Avatar: w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-2 border-white, centered horizontally, overlapping cover with -mt-8, fallback to initials in colored circle. Content area: p-4 pt-10 text-center. Name: font-semibold text-gray-900, verified badge inline if applicable. Username: text-sm text-gray-500 @handle. Short bio: text-sm text-gray-600 line-clamp-2 mt-2. Stats row: flex justify-center gap-4 mt-3, each stat showing count (font-semibold) and label (text-xs text-gray-500). Action buttons: flex gap-2 mt-4 justify-center, "Follow" primary button (bg-black text-white px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm), "Message" secondary or icon button. Hover card variant: position absolute, appears on username/avatar hover in feeds with 200ms delay, shadow-xl, includes more details. Badge: verified blue checkmark (BadgeCheck icon) next to name. Online status: green dot indicator (w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-green-500 absolute) on avatar corner. Mutual indicator: "Followed by UserA, UserB" text in text-xs text-gray-500. Variants: horizontal card (flex row with avatar left, content right), vertical card (centered content, default). Click action: entire card or name clickable to navigate to full profile. Loading: skeleton card with circular avatar placeholder, text lines. Animation: subtle scale on hover (hover:scale-[1.02]). Accessibility: card as article or link, proper alt on avatar.
